title: Jacquet River Campground

services.name: Jacquet River Campground
services.desc: Whether you’re looking to relax, reconnect with nature, or explore local attractions, the Jacquet River Campground offers the perfect escape. Nestled along Route 134 in Belledune on the Bay of Chaleur, our 38-site campground features 30-amp serviced lots, direct water and sewer hookups, clean washroom, shower, and laundry facilities - and a cozy gazebo just for tenters! Staffed 24/7 for your convenience and peace of mind. Enjoy nearby gems like the Jacquet River Gorge, Salmon Barrier, and Roherty Point Beach, or join the fun at seasonal events like Belledune Days and Sounds of Summer. With family-friendly rates and easy access to restaurants, shops, and scenic spots, your next adventure
